title: ioctl_do_kdf: out_zero lock pattern could be clearer
description: The out_zero label (crypto2dev_fd.c:1895-1900) unconditionally acquires state->lock even for early validation failures before the lock was ever held. While the pattern is defensively correct, it obscures intent: for errors raised before line 1776 (mutex_lock), the lock/unlock/lock cycle is unnecessary. Consider either (a) a separate early-exit cleanup path without locking, or (b) explicit comments about why inbuf_clear must be guarded here. The code is safe but could be clearer about which error paths actually need the mutex.
